## Activity

During February 2025, River Outreach recorded 47 captures. This report summarises capture activity for the month and provides the associated image-quality and grading results. The activity total is presented as the number of captures recorded at the site.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed during February 2025, 1 was marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.1% of captures. The result is recorded for monitoring purposes and provides the image-quality position for River Outreach during the reporting period.

## Grading

A total of 8 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 0. This indicates that the recorded median wait for grading was 0 for the month.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during February 2025. Overall, the report records 47 captures, 1 ungradable result, an ungradable rate of 2.1%, 8 referable results, and a median grading lag of 0 for River Outreach.
